title: GRU
paper_title: Learning Phrase Representations Using RNN Encoder-Decoder for Statistical Machine Translation
core_mech: GRU 用 reset/update 两门和单一隐藏状态完成记忆更新，结构比 LSTM 更简洁。
core_mech_en: Simplifies gated recurrence by merging cell and hidden states into a single vector h_t interpolated via an update gate z_t and a reset gate r_t.
input_desc: 时间序列 xt 与上一隐藏状态 ht−1
input_en: Sequential physiological or clinical feature vector x_t and previous hidden state h_{t-1}
output_desc: 当前隐藏状态 ht、全序列表示或逐时刻预测
output_en: Updated hidden state h_t or sequence prediction

source.title: GRU
notes: PyTorch's GRU applies the reset gate after the hidden linear transform; the paper formulation applies it before. This is a documented implementation difference, not an exact 2014 cell reproduction.

adapter.name: GRU
adapter.mechanism: Update and reset gates control recurrent state without a separate cell state.
limitations: Direct PyTorch GRU applies reset after the recurrent linear map; the Cho et al. original formulation places it before. Not claimed bitwise equivalent to that original equation.
